beats.text: Amazon started life under a different name: Cadabra.
beats.note: It was incorporated as Cadabra, Inc. on 5 July 1994.

beats.text: The name was a twist on the magic word Abracadabra.
beats.note: That is how HISTORY describes it.

beats.name: Jeff Bezos
beats.role: Founder who started the company in a rented garage in Bellevue, Washington.

beats.text: Amazon was chosen partly because it starts with A.
beats.note: A name near the start of the alphabet would appear sooner in online searches, and the Amazon is the biggest river in the world.

beats.text: The website opened as a bookshop on 16 July 1995.
beats.note: It billed itself as the world’s largest collection of books for anyone with web access.

beats.text: The shop opened a year and eleven days after the company was founded.

beats.line: Even giants start with a different name.
